verses.gurmukhi: ੧੮ : ਅਨੇਕਤਾ ਵਿਚ ‘ਇਕ’ ਕਰਤੇ ਨੂੰ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਚੇਤਦਾ
verses.translit_en: 18 : anekataa vich 'ika' karate noo(n) keetaa nahee(n) chetadhaa

en.bdb: The creature does not remember unity in divesity of the creator

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਫੁਲੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee paanee vaas hai fulee vaas nivaas cha(n)geree|

en.bdb: Earth resides in water and fragrance resides in flowers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲ ਫੁਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਤਿਤੁ ਪੁਨੀਤੁ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਘਵੇਰੀ ।
verses.translit_en: til fulaa(n) dhe sa(n)g mil patit puneet fulel ghaveree |

en.bdb: The degraded sesame seed mixing with the essence of flowers becomes sanctified as fragrant scent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀਂ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਤਨ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: akhee(n) dhekh anher kar man a(n)dhe tan a(n)dh a(n)dheree|

en.bdb: The blind mind even after beholding through the physical eyes, behaves like a creature living in darkness,i,e. man is spiritually blind though he beholds physically.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਘੁਘੂ ਹੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rut baareh maeh vich sooraj ik na ghughoo heree|

en.bdb: In all the six seasons and twelve months, the same one sun operates but the owl does not see it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਣ ਕੂੰਜ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਛੁ ਪਥਰ ਕੀੜੇ ਰਿਜਕ ਸਵੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: simaran koo(n)j dhiaan kachh pathar keeRe rijak saveree|

en.bdb: Remembrance and meditation nurture the offsprings of florican and tortoise and that Lord provides livelihood to the worms of the stones as well.
Even then the creature (man) does not remember that Creator.
